liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Hard to Handle** (1 review): Listener notes the recording quality is exceptionally good, evident by the song's midpoint [2]
- **Dancing in the Street** (1 review): Listener enjoys the jam in this track, typical of the 1970 era, which brings a smile [4]

## The recordings

- **gd1970-12-17.sbd.unk.87356.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 6 songs; 44 min; rated 4.87/5 by 15 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the audio quality as gorgeous and wishes the recording were longer; Review praises the 1970 recordings, attributing their quality to old multitrack recorders and analog tape; Listener rates the sound quality five stars, describing the 44 minutes of music as beautiful [3][5][9][13]

## Around the show

- Review incorrectly identifies the show as a Garcia and David Crosby performance [3]
- Reviewer compares this era favorably to early 1968, calling it a favorite time for the band [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1970-12-17.sbd.unk.87356.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by fixed by SirMick; source: SBD > Master Reel > Master Cassette? > Cassette > CoolEdit > Flac [1]. Also: Analysis claims this track originates from October 4, 1970, not the listed December date; Source states this song is from October 4, 1970, despite mislabeling on a Rhino CD; Source identifies the track as part of a sampler from the Winterland October 4, 1970 broadcast [1][6][11]
